items.title: Snowy Pine Grove
items.alt: Three differently sized evergreen trees stand close together with snow resting on their layered branches.
items.description: Three differently sized evergreen trees stand close together with snow resting on their layered branches. Use this illustration for winter landscape collage pieces.

items.title: Snowy Owl on a Stump
items.alt: A white snowy owl with golden eyes and brown feather markings stands on a snow-capped stump.
items.description: A white snowy owl with golden eyes and brown feather markings stands on a snow-capped stump. Use this illustration for arctic wildlife classroom displays.

items.title: Polar Bear Cub Walking
items.alt: A fluffy white polar bear cub walks forward with one front paw lifted and its head turned slightly.
items.description: A fluffy white polar bear cub walks forward with one front paw lifted and its head turned slightly. Use this illustration for polar habitat worksheets.

items.title: Squirrel with a Hazelnut
items.alt: A cheerful red squirrel holds a hazelnut between its front paws beneath a tall curling tail.
items.description: A cheerful red squirrel holds a hazelnut between its front paws beneath a tall curling tail. Use this illustration for winter food-storage activity sheets.
